title: Electric field at P
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the electric field strength at P using E = F/q, obtaining 9.0 × 10^5 N/C.

title: Magnitude of charge Q
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnitude of Q using Coulomb's law, obtaining 1.0 × 10^-4 C.

title: Field after removing q
description: Essential: States the electric field strength at point P after removing q is unchanged at 9.0 × 10^5 N/C.

title: Apply Coulomb's law
description: Important: Uses Coulomb's law (F = k|Qq|/r^2) to relate force, charges, and distance for part (2).

title: Distinguish force and field
description: Important: Recognizes that the electric field at a point is defined by the source charge Q and is independent of test charge q.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Shows correct unit analysis (N/C for field, C for charge) in calculations.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns a sign to Q or confuses vector direction with magnitude for charge or field.

title: Misapply field formula
description: Pitfall: Uses E = kq/r^2 (with test charge q) instead of E = F/q or E = kQ/r^2 for part (1) or (3).
